requirements_summary: Latency-sensitive ranking endpoint used in commerce funnel. Primary objective: maximize conversions by returning top-N personalized recommendations in <50ms median and <120ms p99 for a 32-token model response under steady load. Targets: ~600 QPS steady for homepage traffic, spikes to 2k QPS during promotions. Cost-sensitive — need recommendations on batching, prefix/KV caching, and 4-bit/8-bit quantization trade-offs. Must support model rollbacks and A/B canary routing. Data privacy: product+user IDs must remain inside VPC; logs must be auditable.
perf_benchmark_requests: Run Redwood hosted and Dedicated perf bench using our 1-hour production trace (anonymized). Return p50/p95/p99 latencies, tail distribution, GPU utilization, and token cost per 1k requests.
Evaluate automated batching strategies: continuous batching vs fixed-window; provide recommended batch_size distribution and expected latency impact.
Test prefix/KV caching for repeated session prefixes (20% prefix reuse) and measure hit-rate improvements and effect on latency.
Provide quantization profiles (fp16, int8, 4-bit) for our chosen model family with expected quality delta (BLEU/approximate retrieval NDCG) and cost/throughput trade-offs.
Validate fallback routing: when dedicated pool is saturated, route low-risk traffic to hosted variant with graceful degradation; measure switch-over latency and request loss.
Deliver a short runbook for warm-start behavior and autoscale detection to avoid p99 spikes during sudden traffic increases.
